variants.title: 选择预制安装包
variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a polished high-fidelity raster UI design proposal, NOT code, NOT a hand drawn wireframe. A complete Chinese DeepAgent installation modal suitable for a desktop Console. Canvas 1200x1000. Entire modal visible centered, approx 960x750, on a quiet neutral grey scrim, minimal background distraction. Sharp legible Simplified Chinese typography, white modal surface, charcoal text, purple #5145ef primary accent, subtle gray secondary text, tiny 15px stroke icons, no large icon tile. Consistent modal size, compact functional density, excellent typography hierarchy. No fake table, no column headings, no pagination, no heavy grid borders, no gradients or decorative illustrations. Long content may scroll within body, fixed footer, but this representative example fits. Exact source label "预制安装包", never 自带安装包. Binary choices always segmented buttons, not select menus. No fake disabled/unselectable placeholder options; unselected hint belongs in closed field only; clear choice represented by a small x on the field, not a menu option. Status text must say exactly what changes, never "复用". Never include 去配置集成, 返回 Agent, a redundant center 配置 Agent link, schema/version text or prompt disclosure. Render only the requested screen, one modal per image.
Style A: restrained flat Console design. White surface, spacious but compact borderless layout. Horizontal three-step progress indicator beneath modal title; steps "1 选择安装包" "2 检查内容" "3 名称与模型", active purple. No dividing line below stepper. Actions grouped by their meaning with small status icons and light color accents, minimal containers. Footer right aligned.
Screen: step 1, preinstalled source and overwrite mode. Header "安装 Agent" with tiny package-install icon and close x. At top of body compact segmented mode choices "新建 Agent" / "覆盖已有 Agent" with overwrite active. Then target field labelled "覆盖目标" showing selected "电子表格智能助手"; dropdown closed, NO extra menu item. Source tabs "预制安装包" active and "上传安装包". Below two compact full-width selectable rows "DeepCube助手" with "1 Skill · 2 UI 工具", and selected "电子表格智能助手" with "3 Skill · 3 UI 工具". Small package-install icons and radio check, 64px high rows maximum. Small neutral line "将用安装包替换所选 Agent 的配置". Footer "取消" secondary and "下一步" purple.
Outside the modal in small subtle text label this proposal "A · 选择预制安装包". All text precisely typeset, clear professional UI design. Use the referenced style instructions rather than copying the supplied old screenshot layout.
